citation: Rickenlund A, et al. Effects of oral contraceptives on diurnal profiles of insulin, insulin-like growth factor binding protein-1, growth hormone and cortisol in endurance athletes with menstrual disturbance. Hum Reprod. 2010;25(1):85-93.
protocol: 24-h venous serum sampling in 20-min periods, before and during 8 months of a low-dose combined oral contraceptive; standard meals at 08:00, 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and dinner; recorded sleep mostly 23:00-07:00
population: CTR: 8 sedentary, healthy, non-smoking, regularly menstruating women, age 21.1 +/- 4.8 y, BMI 19.3 +/- 1.6; the other arms are endurance athletes (OAM n 9 with menstrual disturbance; RM n 8 regularly menstruating)
note: Serum cortisol and insulin are printed as 24-h AUC, 24-h baseline mean and peaks in Table IV, with mean +/- SD for the CTR group (the Before columns are pre-treatment). No clock-time values are printed, so the 24-h profiles are only in figures. Some Table IV rows are median (IQR), so take the cortisol means and SDs only from rows labelled mean +/- SD.
